thread:
maya: quick heads-up — vendor (APAC) just replied: their A100 pool will be reduced next week, looks like 30% less capacity. need to decide fallback for the demo pool. cc @procurement @sam

sam: thanks maya. can you paste the vendor msg? any specific dates?

maya: vendor note: 'shipments delayed, expected restoration in ~10-12 business days; can offer H100 slots as temporary replacement but rate card differs.' they sent this at 08:14 local.

lee: ok swapping demo pool to H100 is possible but need terraform change + canary plan. I can open a PR now.

raj: do we have H100 quota in apac region? last I checked we had soft quota only. @procurement any insight on quota & billing impact?

procurement: finance flagged a partial-fulfilment invoice hold earlier today (FYI). if we shift to vendor H100 fallback we might hit a higher line item until finance clears. ETA on invoice review ~24-48h from now.

finance-bot: Invoice #INV-3378 flagged for vendor APAC — status: under review. Contact: finance@redwood.ai

maya: thanks. timeline constraint: product demo scheduled Tue 09:00 APAC — we need fallback in place by Monday EOD or scramble.

lee: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452 — change set swaps pool sku from a100 to h100 for demo-standby, adds a canary tag. snippet: ```resource "redwood_pool" "demo-standby" { sku = "h100" canary_count = 1 }```

sam: leaving a quick code review now. two asks: 1) add a rollback var 2) add a comment about cost delta so sales is aware.

lee: will add both. one more question — do we route low-latency demo traffic to eu fallback if apac capacity is short?

maya: prefer to keep demo in APAC for latency. eu fallback OK only if H100 not available and finance approves cross-region usage.

raj: oncall: can you monitor the canary after deploy? if KV cache warms slowly we may need extra warm-up scripts. @deploy-bot can you schedule a smoke run after canary?

deploy-bot: scheduled smoke job: demo-canary-smoke at 2024-11-18T21:30:00Z. Will report results back here.

lee: updated PR with rollback var and cost note. tagging @product-sales in PR description for awareness.

procurement: will escalate invoice review to priority. if approved before EOD Monday, we can proceed with vendor fallback and invoice will flow. else finance requires manual exception.

maya: great — plan for now: lee to merge PR with canary, deploy canary overnight, raj to watch metrics, procurement to push finance. I'll notify product-sales about cost delta and fallback plan.

sam: lgtm, leaving an approve once canary passes. :thumbsup:

maya: thanks everyone — I'll post an update if vendor status changes.
